verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs such as llms.txt are a fair question for a SaaS product with a Web API, so the axis applies. A probe of llms.txt on the Web API host returned HTTP 404. The pack shows no llms.txt, no agent-oriented documentation and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec; the only documentation evidence is a conventional Web API docs page, which does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
